I asked Claude code to formalize with lean a proof for the knuth 3d hamiltonian cycles problem (odd cases for now) that also solved experimentally by claude - https://www-cs-faculty.stanford.edu/~knuth/papers/claude-cycles.pdf

https://github.com/rkirov/claude-cycles-lean

Read more in the human notes section in the README.

Hope that is of some curiosity as an artifact of current capabilities of AI. I don't aim to restart flamewars around slopproofs and mathlib.
Yea you might be interested in #Machine Learning for Theorem Proving > Don Knuth and Claude
lol, great minds think alike haha. Interesting to compare all these proofs.
oh and thank you for the link. Keeping up with all the zulip threads needs and AI solution of its own.
